build.title: Plugin manager + settings tabs for every app (Fable rebuild)

said.text: Every plugin gets a plugin-manager entry (info, enable/disable, view logs, settings). Plugins never ship their own settings screen; they add tabs to the app settings interface. Every app compiled by the build engine ships the settings interface and lib-settings. The Opus version is the console plugin `plugin-manager` (web console only: four views cards/table/detail/dependency graph in four layouts Studio/Mission control/Terminal/Catalog, default context-menu link, dependencies in detail, opens each plugin's UI and settings, logs, files, install & uninstall). Remove it first with its uninstall script (uninstall.mjs --all --publish), then build the cross-port version following plugin-lifecycle@1 (Android kernel + every app the build engine compiles), keeping the UI-editor rules (last save wins per key; reload current values on open/load/focus).
